tasks.name: Assassin's Feed
tasks.desc: Eagle-dive into a hay cart after completing Diamond in the Rough.
tasks.notes:
Eagle-dive into a hay cart from on top of the Al Kharid bank after completing the Diamond in the Rough quest.
The spot where the player has to jump off can be reached by dropping off the west side of the roof of Al Kharid Palace, shimmying across the rope and then dropping off the rug to the south. Alternately, repeat the The creed section of the Stolen Hearts quest, and instead of using the grapple walk south and dive off the Al Kharid bank.
An alternative, faster route after the quest is to go up to the palace roof from the northwest staircase, drop off the west side, and then shimmy-across the rope to get to the roof of the bank.

tasks.name: Touring Gear
tasks.desc: Equip a full set of desert clothing while standing in the desert.
tasks.notes:
Equip a full set of desert clothing while standing in the desert.
The set can be bought from Shantay at Shantay Pass. Wearing either black desert robe or black desert shirt will not complete the achievement.

tasks.name: Memento Mori
tasks.desc: View the memorial board at Het's Oasis.
tasks.notes: View the Memorial Board at the northern edge of Het's Oasis. The board is found near the Het's Oasis bank, south of the Mage Training Arena.

tasks.name: Fool's Gold
tasks.desc: Catch a golden warbler.
tasks.notes:
Catch a golden warbler with the use of a bird snare. Golden warblers can be found just east of the Dominion Tower.
Protean traps do not work.

tasks.name: Don't You Dare Close Your Eyes
tasks.desc: Use any of the magic carpets in the desert.
tasks.notes: Use any of the magic carpets in the desert.

tasks.name: Slash Fund
tasks.desc: Get water from a cactus in the desert.
tasks.notes: Fill a waterskin with water from a Kharidian cactus in the desert.

tasks.name: Kookookachat
tasks.desc: Talk to Khoochak about a quest.
tasks.notes: Talk to Khoochak in the throne room of Al Kharid palace about a quest.

tasks.name: Fire at Will
tasks.desc: Craft a fire rune at the fire altar.
tasks.notes: Craft a fire rune at the fire altar, which can be found west of Het's Oasis.

tasks.name: Seems Legit
tasks.desc: Obtain five artefacts from Pyramid Plunder.
tasks.notes:
Obtain five artefacts from Pyramid Plunder.
A Pharaoh's sceptre may be used to bypass the quest requirement to get into Pyramid Plunder, Ironmen will still have to start Icthlarin's Little Helper.

tasks.name: Extra Cheese
tasks.desc: Exchange pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena.
tasks.notes:
Exchange Pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena, by buying any of the rewards.
They can exchange their points at the Rewards Guardian, which is located on the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US).

tasks.name: I Like to Watch
tasks.desc: Attempt to spectate on a match at the Dominion Tower.
tasks.notes: Attempt to spectate on a match at the Dominion Tower.

tasks.name: Wiggle Room
tasks.desc: Perform the troubadour dance emote near the dancers outside the Citharede Abbey.
tasks.notes:
Perform the Troubadour Dance emote near the dancers outside the Citharede Abbey.
Using the 'dance-with' option on the dancers will not work. The player must use the Troubadour Dance emote from the emote tab in the chatbox.

tasks.name: Faster than a Speeding Bullet
tasks.desc: Ride an eagle to the desert.
tasks.notes: Ride an eagle to the desert by using a rope on the Desert eagle inside the Eagles' Peak Dungeon.

tasks.name: So Su Me
tasks.desc: Solve an easy runedoku casket.
tasks.notes:
Solve an easy Runedoku casket by choosing the "examine lock" option rather than force or pick lock.
If either the force or pick lock option is chosen, the player will have to wait till daily reset to try again.

tasks.name: A Bridge Not Far
tasks.desc: Cross the River Lum using a crossbow.
other: 59 Fletching Fletching (b) (to fletch mithril grapple)
30 Smithing Smithing (b) (to smith mithril grapple)
tasks.notes:
Cross the River Lum using a crossbow and mithril grapple.
The shortcut from Lumbridge Swamp to Al Kharid is located south of the Lumbridge cemetery. Equip the crossbow and grapple and click "grapple" on the strong tree on the Lumbridge side of the river. The enhanced grappling hook from the toolbelt works.

tasks.name: Heathen Idle
tasks.desc: Pray at the Elidinis statuette in Nardah.
tasks.notes: Pray at the Elidinis Statuette in Nardah after the Spirits of the Elid quest.

tasks.name: Away with the Kalphites
tasks.desc: Travel to the fairy ring near the Kalphite Lair.
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes: Travel to the Fairy ring that is located near the Kalphite Hive, by using the Fairy ring code BIQ.

tasks.name: All Square
tasks.desc: Sell a pyramid top to Simon.
tasks.notes: Sell a pyramid top to Simon, which can be obtained by completing the Agility Pyramid, and choosing the 'Climb Climbing rocks' option on the west side of the doorway before finishing the course.

tasks.name: Goat Harralander?
tasks.desc: Create a vial of combat potion from scratch in Nardah after killing a goat from the desert. (X/6)
tasks.notes: Make a combat potion from scratch inside Nardah.

tasks.name: Taken for Granite
tasks.desc: Mine granite at the quarry south of the Bandit Camp.
tasks.notes: Mine granite at the desert quarry south of the Bandit Camp.

tasks.name: Unbeetleable
tasks.desc: Create a spirit kalphite pouch at the obelisk south west of Pollnivneach.
tasks.notes:
Create a spirit kalphite pouch at the obelisk south-west of Pollnivneach across the river. In case you cannot locate it, it is actually on the opposite bank of the T.A.R.D.I.S. icy patch in the desert. The Obelisk is underground so you have to look out for a Desert Ladder to climb down.
Alternatively, you can create the pouch at the obelisk inside Psamtik's shop in Menaphos for this achievement to be recognised.
The pouch can be made with a blue charm, a pouch, 51 spirit shards, and a potato cactus.

tasks.name: An Teak
tasks.desc: Attempt to cut a log from the teak tree near the Ruins of Uzer.
tasks.notes: Cut a log from the teak tree near the Ruins of Uzer.

tasks.name: Overcut
tasks.desc: Boost your stats at Amascut's altar.
tasks.notes:
Boost their stats at the Amascut's altar, which is located inside the Uzer Mastaba south of Uzer.
Completion of Missing My Mummy and repairing all the statues is required before gaining the option to pray at Amascut's statue.

tasks.name: Skinful
tasks.desc: Use Humidify to fill a waterskin while standing in the desert.
tasks.notes: Fill a waterskin with the use of the Humidify spell, while standing in the Desert.

tasks.name: Water on the Brain
tasks.desc: Equip a charged enchanted water tiara while in the desert.
tasks.notes:
Equip a charged enchanted water tiara while in the desert.
The enchanted tiara can be made by using 3 water runes on a water tiara for each charge.

tasks.name: More Fletcher than Sumona
tasks.desc: Fletch some broad bolts or arrows in Sumona's house.
tasks.notes:
Fletch some broad-tipped bolts or arrows in Sumona's house.
To fletch broad bolts or arrows, the ability to do so must first be bought for 300 slayer points from any slayer master.
One broad arrowheads and headless arrow are needed for the arrows, or one unfinished broad bolts and feather.

tasks.name: Ug Thankee Kindly
tasks.desc: Make an ugthanki kebab from raw ingredients in Nardah.
tasks.notes:
Make an ugthanki kebab from raw ingredients in Nardah, all which can be bought from the Grand Exchange.
To make ugthanki kebab the player will need the following ingredients: an onion, a tomato, an empty bowl, raw ugthanki meat, a pot of flour, and a bucket of water.

tasks.name: Nipped in the Bug
tasks.desc: Use a dreadnip on the Kalphite Queen.
other: Defeat at least 450 bosses in the Dominion Tower
tasks.notes:
Use a dreadnip on the Kalphite Queen. Using it on the Exiled Kalphite Queen will not work. It is not necessary to kill the Kalphite Queen.
To avoid risking death or having to pay 100,000 coins, the achievement can be completed in practice mode.

tasks.name: Drafty in Here
tasks.desc: Kill a dust devil in the Smoke Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Kill a Dust devil in the Smoke Dungeon.
It is recommended to wear a face mask, a slayer helmet, or a full slayer helmet to prevent them from lowering stats and dealing rapid damage to the player.
Having your slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand also works.

tasks.name: Enaqua
tasks.desc: Fill a waterskin from the fountain in Enakhra's Temple.
tasks.notes:
Fill a waterskin from the fountain inside of the Enakhra's Temple.
Use the lodestone to Bandit Camp. Run south west around the edge of the rock formation to find the entrance to Enakhra's Temple. There will be a square opening in the ground and to the east of it is the option to 'Climb-down Secret entrance'. Climb down the ladder and make your way to the middle room. Go up the ladder. The fountain is to the west.

tasks.name: Say It, Don't Spray It
tasks.desc: Hear one of Al the Camel's poems using a fully featured cramulet.
tasks.notes: Listen to one of Al the Camel's poems using a fully upgraded cramulet.

tasks.name: 1001 Kharidian Spikes
tasks.desc: Harvest spines from a cactus you grew yourself in Al Kharid.
tasks.notes:
Harvest spines from a self-grown cactus, which can be planted in the cactus patch in north-eastern Al Kharid using a cactus seed. Het's Oasis cactus patch does not count for this achievement.
For six cadava berries, the player can have the nearby farmer, Ayesha, protect it from disease.
A Supreme growth potion (leafy) can be used to expedite the process.

tasks.name: Ice-Cold Killer
tasks.desc: Freeze an enemy in the desert with Ice Burst.
tasks.notes: Cast the Ice Burst spell on an enemy in the Desert.

tasks.name: Ludikeris
tasks.desc: Kill a scarab mage, locust rider or kalphite with the Keris dagger.
tasks.notes:
Kill a scarab mage, locust rider or kalphite with the keris dagger.
Killing the scarab mage or locust rider in the Giant scarab fight in the Dominion Tower or killing scabarites in Ullek swamp will not count for the achievement, nor will using the primed keris and its variants.

tasks.name: Security through Obscurity
tasks.desc: Use the deposit chest near the Bedabin Camp.
tasks.notes: Use the deposit chest near the Bedabin Camp. It is not required to bank an item.

tasks.name: Open Sesame
tasks.desc: Enter the Al Kharid Resource Dungeon.
tasks.notes: Enter the Al Kharid Resource Dungeon, which is located in the mining site north of Al Kharid.

tasks.name: Staff on Stryke
tasks.desc: Kill a desert strykewyrm wearing a Full Slayer Helm and wielding an ancient staff.
tasks.notes:
Kill a desert strykewyrm while wearing a full slayer helmet and wielding an ancient staff.
A player may use a full slayer helmet or any upgraded variants, as well as any recoloured version of those, but not a normal slayer helmet. If the player has their slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand at the Slayer Lodge, it must be removed and worn for the kill to count. The staff cannot be borrowed. Any equipment can be used during the fight, but in order to complete the achievement, the staff and helmet must be equipped when the final blow is dealt and the monster is killed. When all requirements are met, a player does not need a slayer task to kill a strykewyrm. Using a familiar will draw the strykewyrm's attention and cause it to stop fighting, yielding the message "It's not after you..."

tasks.name: Room Service
tasks.desc: Open the sarcophagus in the final room of Pyramid Plunder.
tasks.notes: Open the engraved sarcophagus in the final room of Pyramid Plunder.

tasks.name: Sun Shade
tasks.desc: Plant a dominion marker in the desert, with all its achievements complete, including killing Sunfreet.
quests: Recipe for Disaster: Defeating the Culinaromancer
tasks.notes: Plant the dominion marker (stage 4) in the Desert. This marker can be unlocked after completing all achievements from the Dominion Tower, excluding the Rumble Mode achievements.

tasks.name: A, B, Cithara
tasks.desc: Play the Holy Cithara while standing in the Citharede Abbey.
tasks.notes:
Play the Holy Cithara while standing in the Citharede Abbey.
The Holy Cithara can be found by searching the reliquary in the basement of Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede after meeting certain "Holy" requirements.

tasks.name: Ankle Support
tasks.desc: Wear the ankh and the Scabaras mask while in the desert.
other: 80 Mining Mining (nb)
tasks.notes:
Equip the ankh, which can be found in the Apmeken tomb and the Scabaras mask, which can be found in the Scabaras tomb while in the Kharidian Desert.
Entering the desert while having the items already equipped will not complete the achievement.

tasks.name: I'm Super
tasks.desc: In Nardah, make a super antifire flask - making both the flask and potion from scratch.
tasks.notes:
Make a super antifire flask from scratch in Nardah.
To make a super antifire flask, the player will the need following items: 2 phoenix feathers, 2 antifire (3), and a robust glass.

subs.html: Use both phoenix feathers on both antifire (3) to create 2 super antifire potions (3) (the instructions mistakenly say "make antifire potion" instead of "make super antifire potion". The player does not need to make the antifire potions from scratch, only the super antifire).
Create a potion flask with the robust glass
Combine both super antifire potions (3) to make 1 super antifire flask (6)
